content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any rate/latency or trigger-allocation documents needed to extract the three allowed algorithm names, their Level-1 FPGA latencies, and the allocated trigger-rate definition."},{"id":"s2","description":"Apply the hard latency constraint from candidate_specs.md: exclude any candidate with latency greater than 4.0 us, and record the numeric latency for each candidate using record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each latency-allowed candidate, run simulate_efficiency at a coarse set of thresholds spanning 20 to 60 GeV, e.g. 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 GeV, and record each returned signal efficiency."},{"id":"s4","description":"Refine around the best-performing threshold region for each viable candidate by running simulate_efficiency at additional nearby thresholds, especially near the highest threshold that still satisfies rate allocation if applicable and near any 80% efficiency boundary; record all numeric efficiencies."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all simulated points that satisfy threshold range, allocated-rate condition as returned by the simulation, efficiency at least 80%, and latency at most 4.0 us; identify the algorithm-threshold pair with the highest signal efficiency and prepare it as the single recommendation for the reporting module."}]}
